req.title: Return 404 for unknown squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall return HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-005 requires HTTP 404 when no player has the requested squad number. The database contains squad numbers 1-26. Tests must cover: (1) a positive case confirming a known squad number returns 200 (proving the 404 path is conditional, not universal), (2) a negative/error-path case confirming an unknown squad number returns exactly 404, (3) boundary cases at squad number 0 (below minimum), 27 (one above max seeded), and a large number. Mutation resilience requires asserting the exact status code 404 (not >=400), testing both sides of the existence check, and verifying the response body is not a valid player payload.

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_known_squad_number_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'

test_known_squad_number_returns_200()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_decision_table_known_vs_unknown_squad_numbers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_exists = client.get('/players/squadnumber/13')
    assert r_exists.status_code == 200
    assert r_exists.json()['squadNumber'] == 13
    r_missing = client.get('/players/squadnumber/100')
    assert r_missing.status_code == 404
    r_max = client.get('/players/squadnumber/26')
    assert r_max.status_code == 200
    assert r_max.json()['squadNumber'] == 26
    r_above_max = client.get('/players/squadnumber/27')
    assert r_above_max.status_code == 404

test_decision_table_known_vs_unknown_squad_numbers()
